tools.name: a2a_call_agent
tools.description:
Call any public A2A-compatible agent directly by its endpoint URL.

    Returns the agent's response immediately (synchronous — no task_id needed).
    Get agent_url values from discover_agents (look for ENDPOINT in results).
    Works with any agent on a2aregistry.org or any A2A JSON-RPC endpoint.

tools.name: wait_for_task
tools.description:
Wait for a platform agent task to complete and return its result.

    Only needed when a platform agent tool returned STATUS=RUNNING with a task_id
    (i.e. the task was still running after the initial 50s inline wait).
    NOT needed when the tool already returned STATUS=COMPLETED or STATUS=FAILE

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description:
Find agents to call — both platform agents and public A2A registry agents.

    Returns two types:
    • TYPE=platform — built-in agents, call via their MCP tool name (async, returns task_id → use wait_for_task)
    • TYPE=a2a_registry — public agents from a2aregistry.org, call via a2a_call_agent(ag

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description:
Fetch a ClawHub skill by slug — metadata plus optional SKILL.md body.

    Use the slug from search_skills results (e.g. 'agent-browser-clawdbot').
    The response includes version, stats, install command, and the SKILL.md content
    agents can follow to adopt the skill's behavior.

    Free to us

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: a2a_call_agent, discover_agents, search_skills · Private data: search_skills, get_skill, exploitagent · Public sink: a2a_call_agent, search_skills · Destructive: softwareengineeringexpert, taskplanner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: a2a_call_agent, discover_agents, search_skills · Private data: search_skills, get_skill, exploitagent · Public sink: a2a_call_agent, search_skills · Destructive: softwareengineeringexpert, taskplanner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
